issue.title: Retire agent_auto_restart
issue.description: Automatic one-time relaunch of agents broken by a live sase update

task_type_fields.remove_when: the land phase deletes the Off branches and makes the On branches unconditional
task_type_fields.when_disabled: no automatic path acts; pending failures are re-surfaced loudly and the ledger is never written
task_type_fields.when_enabled: sase agent auto-restart run may claim the ledger and relaunch pre-provider update-skew failures once per lineage
